messages.subject: Pie chart order
parts: As of last week I had a chunk that created pie charts in order of largest slice to smallest going clockwise starting at 12. now when the code runs it creates the slices in descending alphabetical order (z-a) starting at 12. Why did this change? (my data input remains the same, I double checked). Was there an update lately?

messages.author: afa3a78132320260
messages.subject: Re: Pie chart order
parts:
Positions changed a while ago to behave better in relation to the legend in non-polar coordinates (i.e the first factor level is now stacked on top instead of on the bottom). Depending on whether you used stacking or filling, you can revert to the old behavior with position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
or position = position_fill(reverse  = TRUE).

HTH,
Wouter
